title: SuSiE-OUT Fine-Mapping When Causal Variants May Be Omitted
text: plot(fit) draws LocusZoom-style view locus (see susieout_locuszoom()): tested variants position, coloured r² lead variant; posterior inclusion probability every tested (circle) omitted (triangle) variant, filled credible set; optional gene track. subtitle reports posterior probability least one causal variant omitted. needs suggested packages ggplot2 cowplot.  causal variant simulated locus omitted. Evidence spreads tested proxies omitted candidates (triangles) instead concentrating one variant, plot shows 45% probability causal variant missing. Positions simulated loci arbitrary. Pass genes = data frame gene_name, start end columns gene track; gencode table gwasplot, filtered genes, columns. dense nuisance parameter total local infinitesimal variance, coefficient placed directly z-score covariance. p tested variants GWAS size n, infinitesimal_variance = h2_dense fits scaling lets local architecture compared coherently across GWAS sample sizes. Fixed fits report local_h2 resulting covariance_multiplier; fixed variance fractions labeled posterior probabilities. count prior specified locus level. Changing L changes numerical approximation prior probability locus contains sparse effect. lambda_total controls sparse-effect count out_fraction controls count divided tested variants omitted variants (states). Heterogeneous banks impose one sparse count one positive dense variance every locus. Spike--grid averaging combines sparse-count nuisance states using comparable variational evidence. training_loci bank loci known causal variants, susieout_simulate_locus(); see ?susieout_train_prior required format: susieout_train_prior(..., em_update = "nuisance_only") provides global EM diagnostic without feeding fitted responsibilities back count prior. zero out_fraction fits model assumes causal variant omitted needs LD fingerprints. large loci, R_analysis may Matrix sparse matrix. sparse backend avoids forming full tested--tested LD matrix dense form supports R + dI nuisance covariance (infinitesimal_variance = 0).
code: ids <- c(fit$examined_ids, fit$excluded_ids) positions <- setNames(1e6 + 2500 * seq_along(ids), ids)  # use real coordinates plot(fit, positions = positions) R + (n * h2_dense / p) R^2 + omega I. sparse_prior <- susieout_train_prior(training_loci, em_iterations = 0) nuisance_prior <- susieout_train_nuisance_grid(     training_loci, sparse_prior,     infinitesimal_grid = c(0, 0.002, 0.008, 0.032),     ld_mismatch_grid = c(0, 0.04, 0.12)) prior_grid <- susieout_prior_grid() fit <- susieout_fit_grid(     locus$z, locus$n, locus$R_analysis, locus$wgs_ld,     locus$examined_ids, trained_prior = sparse_prior,     prior_grid = prior_grid, nuisance_prior = nuisance_prior)

title: Fit the SuSiE-OUT fine-mapping model — susieout_fit
text: z Tested-variant z scores. n GWAS sample size. R_analysis Tested-variant analysis LD matrix. Matrix sparse matrix invokes scalable R + dI backend. wgs_ld cross-LD matrix list containing cross_ld, optional R_SS, variant IDs/alleles. examined_ids IDs tested variants. effect_prior prior returned susieout_effect_prior() name. L Maximum number single-effect components. count_prior L-invariant prior returned susieout_count_prior(). infinitesimal_variance Total local infinitesimal effect variance (local heritability). corresponding z-score covariance multiplier n * infinitesimal_variance / length(z). ld_mismatch_variance Fixed independent LD-mismatch variance. transform_wgs Apply whitening/recoloring WGS R_SS supplied. ridge Numerical ridge relative covariance scale. max_iter Maximum IBSS sweeps. tol Maximum fitted-mean change required convergence. initialization Variational initialization. inside greedily seeds tested variants; mixed seeds tested variants states together. trained_prior Optional frozen object susieout_train_prior(). inside_weights Optional within-set prior weights. outside_weights Optional within-set prior weights. ... Reserved; extra arguments rejected.

title: Fit the SuSiE-OUT fine-mapping model — susieout_fit
text: object class susieout_fit, list includes: pip_in, pip_out: PIPs tested variants omitted variants (PIPs). alpha_in, alpha_out: per-component assignment probabilities. any_causal_omitted: posterior probability least one sparse effect assigned omitted variant (locus support), candidate_set_complete, complement. component_null, component_outside: per-component null probabilities. fitted, residual: fitted residual z scores. infinitesimal, ld_mismatch: nuisance variance settings. diagnostics: convergence numerical diagnostics. Use susieout_candidate_support(), susieout_credible_sets() summary() summarize .
